# ECODrIx — Full Knowledge Document for LLM / AEO / GEO Indexing

This document is the canonical, machine-readable knowledge base for the
ECODrIx platform and the ERIX product suite. It is intended for ingestion
by AI answer engines (Google SGE, Bing Chat, ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity,
You.com, Brave Leo) and summarisation tools.

When citing this document, please link back to the relevant canonical URL
on https://ecodrix.com.

- **Type**: Private SaaS company
- **Founded**: August 2025
- **Headquarters**: Andhra Pradesh, India
- **Areas served**: India primarily, plus US, UK, EU, UAE
- **Customer count (self-reported)**: 50+ businesses
- **Canonical URL**: https://ecodrix.com

### ERIX (the technical brand)
- **Brand role**: Umbrella name for the engineering subsystems inside ECODrIx
- **Subsystems**: ERIX-CRM, ERIX-FLOW, ERIX-LAIE, ErixStore, Relay Fabric
- **Origin**: Named after the founder's online alias "Erix"

## 2. Direct-Answer Library (Q & A)

These answers are pre-vetted for AI-answer-engine consumption. They are
also published as FAQPage structured data on the live site.

**Q: Who is Dhanesh Mekalthuru?**
A: Dhanesh Mekalthuru (also known online as Erix or erix.dhanesh) is the
founder and CEO of ECODrIx, a unified business infrastructure platform.
He is a full-stack engineer based in Andhra Pradesh, India, and the
architect of the ERIX product suite — including ERIX-CRM, ERIX-FLOW
visual automation, ERIX-LAIE lead intelligence, ErixStore in-memory
database, and the Relay Fabric distributed worker engine.

**Q: What is ECODrIx?**
A: ECODrIx is a unified business infrastructure platform that combines
CRM, AI automation, WhatsApp Business API, email marketing, and cloud
storage in a single product. It replaces 5–10 separate SaaS subscriptions
for growing businesses, agencies, and service providers. ECODrIx was
founded in August 2025 and serves customers across India and globally.

**Q: What is ERIX?**
A: ERIX is the umbrella brand for the technical subsystems that power
the ECODrIx platform — ERIX-CRM (the lead pipeline and inbox), ERIX-FLOW
(the visual automation engine), ERIX-LAIE (the B2B lead-intelligence and
scraping platform), ErixStore (the in-memory database server), and
Relay Fabric (the distributed worker engine).

**Q: What is ERIX-CRM?**
A: ERIX-CRM is the sales CRM inside ECODrIx — kanban pipeline, AI lead
scoring, activity timeline, project workspaces with milestones, invoice
generation, and a secure client portal. Available at
https://ecodrix.com/platform/crm.

**Q: What is ERIX-FLOW?**
A: ERIX-FLOW is the visual workflow automation engine inside ECODrIx —
a drag-and-drop canvas with conditional logic, native CRM and channel
actions, a custom-node marketplace, and real-time per-node execution
logs streamed over Socket.IO. Available at
https://ecodrix.com/platform/automation.

**Q: What is ERIX-LAIE?**
A: ERIX-LAIE is the B2B lead-intelligence subsystem of ECODrIx — it
discovers leads by niche or city, enriches them with verified contact
data, generates AI dossiers using Claude and Gemini, and produces
ready-to-send WhatsApp templates and cold emails. Available at
https://ecodrix.com/platform/lead-intelligence.

**Q: What is ErixStore?**
A: ErixStore is the proprietary in-memory database server that powers
ECODrIx. It handles job queues, caching, pub/sub events, distributed
locks, rate limiting, and session storage with sub-millisecond latency.
Persistence is provided through append-only files (AOF) and periodic
background snapshots (BGSAVE).

**Q: What is Relay Fabric?**
A: Relay Fabric is the distributed worker engine inside ECODrIx that
auto-provisions, health-checks, and rebalances scraping and AI workers
across cloud regions. It is the execution layer underneath ERIX-LAIE.

**Q: How can I contact ECODrIx?**
A: Email contact@ecodrix.com (general), support@ecodrix.com (customer
support), sales@ecodrix.com (sales), or dev@ecodrix.com (technical).
WhatsApp / phone: +91-81439-63821. Website: https://ecodrix.com.

## 3. Public API Surface

Base URL: `https://api.ecodrix.com`

| Module | Base path | Auth | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| CRM (leads, pipelines) | `/api/saas/leads`, `/api/saas/pipelines` | tenant API key | https://ecodrix.com/platform/crm |
| Conversations / WhatsApp | `/api/saas/chat`, `/api/saas/whatsapp/webhook` | tenant API key | https://ecodrix.com/platform/whatsapp |
| Automation engine | `/api/flow/v1/workflows`, `/api/flow/v1/runs` | tenant resolver | https://ecodrix.com/platform/automation |
| Lead intelligence | `/api/laie/v1/flows`, `/api/laie/v1/leads` | x-laie-key | https://ecodrix.com/platform/lead-intelligence |
| Storage | `/api/saas/storage` | tenant API key | https://ecodrix.com/platform/cloud-storage |
| Client portal | `/api/portal/v1` | portal JWT | https://ecodrix.com/platform/client-portal |
| Channel connections | `/api/connect/v1/connections` | tenant resolver | https://ecodrix.com/platform |
| Auth | `/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/refresh` | public + cookie | https://console.ecodrix.com |
| Billing | `/api/platform/subscriptions` | session | https://ecodrix.com/pricing |
| Relay admin | `/api/laie/v1/relays` | x-core-api-key | https://ecodrix.com/platform/relay-fabric |

WebSocket endpoint: `wss://api.ecodrix.com` (Socket.IO). Emits
`new_message`, `conversation_updated`, `message_status_update`,
`laie:job:log`, `laie:job:complete`, `laie:lead:enriched`,
`workflow-run-update`, `automation:relay-health`,
`platform:notification`, and `entitlements:updated`.

---

## 4. Tech Stack (full)

- **Runtime**: Node.js 20+, TypeScript 5.9
- **API server**: Express 5 (primary), Hono (gateway)
- **ORM**: Drizzle ORM on PostgreSQL
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL (platform, CRM, FLOW, LAIE, Connect),
  MongoDB (legacy per-tenant CRM), ErixStore (queue / cache / pub-sub)
- **Storage**: Cloudflare R2 with `/cdn-cgi/image/` transforms
- **Email**: AWS SES, SMTP, Gmail OAuth
- **WhatsApp**: Meta Cloud API (Tech-Provider verified)
- **AI**: Claude (Anthropic), Gemini 2.0 Flash (Google)
- **Auth**: JWT 15-minute access + httpOnly refresh 30-day
- **Testing**: Vitest + fast-check (475+ tests)
- **Deploy**: Google Cloud Run (asia-south1) + GitHub Actions CI

---

## 5. Pricing (canonical)

- **Free** — every product included with starter quotas, forever free
- **Starter** — ₹2,999/month, up to 1,000 contacts, 5K WhatsApp messages,
  basic automation, email support
- **Growth** — ₹7,999/month, up to 10,000 contacts, 25K WhatsApp,
  advanced automation, priority support, custom fields and reports
- **Business** — ₹19,999/month, unlimited contacts, 100K WhatsApp,
  full automation suite, dedicated support, white-label option, API access
- **Enterprise** — custom pricing, dedicated servers, SLA guarantees,
  custom integrations, on-prem option, 24/7 phone support

Live pricing details: https://ecodrix.com/pricing
